title: Two menu entries when talking to a departed Lys are both labeled 'ask after her brother' with no visible distinction, but one is flagged '(Lys -1)' and the other '(Lys +1)' - a player cannot tell which is which before choosing, unlike almost every other consequence-tagged choice in the game which differentiates its options' wording.
where: The Burned Glade - talking to Lys, two identically-worded 'ask after her brother' options
